description: This file declares the NetworkInterfaceManager class, which provides methods to open existing network interfaces, apply changes to them, and create new instances of the manager. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and interacts with other network-related classes such as NetlinkClient and NetworkInterface.

classes.name: NetworkInterfaceManager
classes.description: Manages network interfaces, allowing opening existing interfaces, applying changes, and creating new manager instances.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens an existing network interface by name, returning a NetworkInterface object (details not filled in yet).

methods.name: ApplyChanges
methods.description: Applies modifications to an existing network interface; cannot be used to create new interfaces.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of NetworkInterfaceManager using a provided NetlinkClientFactory.
